study: Strict historical original-vintage Treasury real yield (DFII10), Treasury 10Y-2Y curve (T10Y2Y), broad USD index DTWEXBGS (available only after first actual series publication 2019-02-04) vs Bitcoin +50% and -35% 26-week outcomes and existing BTC/Fed/Chicago factors.
population: Only 684 exact BTCI v8.17.1 Sunday rows for 2012-2025, no new dates, parent SHA identical. Exclude unavailable source rows with transparent explicit UNKNOWN and common same-cohort denominators. USD cohort restricted to Sunday >=2019-02-10.
sourceMethod: FRED original as-of Sunday by realtime_start=realtime_end Sunday, or faster multi-vintage retrieval output_type=2 if validated against independent Sunday calls for a 2018 and 2024 vintage. Observation latest 2-10 days prior, 4wk comparison historical 25-35 days previous. Do not access vintages unavailable before series first publication. Archive exact source bytes, SHA readback and source status.

factors.D_TIGHT: DTWEXBGS 4-week percent change >0; use only after actual first release 2019-02-04
factors.A: BTC weekly up from pinned BTCI
factors.F: Fed liquidity positive from pinned BTCI

candidateControls: A AND F AND N AND J
A AND F AND N AND J AND R_EASE
NOT A AND NOT F AND NOT N AND NOT J
NOT A AND NOT F AND NOT N AND NOT J AND R_TIGHT
NOT A AND R_TIGHT AND D_TIGHT (2019+)
outcomes: Keep frozen v8.17.1 outcomes UP13/UP26/UP52, DOWN13/DOWN26/DOWN52, POSITIVE13/POSITIVE26/POSITIVE52. Main UP26=BTC maximum in next26 weeks >=+50% vs original Sunday, main DOWN26=BTC minimum daily close next26wk <=-35% vs Sunday.
report: Per model confusion matrix TP FP FN TN, precision recall, matched baseline rates, adverse risk when bullish; 14-week and 27-week nonoverlap; historical periods 2012,2013-16,2017-19,2020-23,2024-25. Report factual data gaps and sources.
limitations: No new OOS, historical data already inspected repeatedly, overlapping outcomes and small macro cycles, dollar never claim historical availability before 2019 first publication, don't claim causality or trading edge.
guard: RESEARCH_ONLY no Spot/Futures/NAV/MASTER/P&L/capital/reserve/Detector/limits changes or trading activity.
